content: Yihuda Sheeshi
Isra7eele adde nayti haysata; Robeela, Simoona, Leewe, Yihuda, Yisakoora, Zabloona,
Daane, Yoosefa, Biniyaame, Niftaaleme, Gaadenne Aseera.
Kanaane maccase Sewape Yihudi yelida heedzu adde nayti Era, Onaananne Seela. Yihuda bayra na7ay Eri Godaa sinthan iitabaa oothida gisho Goday iya wodhis.
Yihudi ba na7aa mache Timaaripe Faaresanne Zaara yelis. Yihudas ichashu adde nayti de7oosona.
Faaresa adde nayti Hesiroomanne Hamuula.
Zaara adde nayti Zimira, Etaana, Hemaana, Kalkolanne Dara; enti kumethi ichasha.
Zaara koche gidida Karma na7ay Akaani Xoossas dummatida di7uwape kaysotidi Isra7eele asaa un7ethidaysa.
Etaana na7ay Azaara.
Esroomepe Dawita Gakanaw
Hesrooni yelida nayti Yiram7eela, Araamenne Kaaleba.
Araami Amnadaabe yelis. Amnadaabey Yihuda kochata halaqa Na7asoona yelis.
Na7asooni Salmoona yelis; Salmooni Boo7eza yelis;
Boo7ezi Iyyobeda yelis; Iyyobedi Isseye yelis.
Isseyey ba bayra na7aa Eliyaaba, kaalo na7aa Amnadaabe, heedzantho na7aa Saama,
oyddantho na7aa Natina7eela, ichashantho na7aa Radaya,
usupuntho na7aa Asama, laapuntho na7aa Dawita yelis.
Isseye macca nayti Xaruyonne Abigiya. Xaruyi nayti heedzati Abisaya, Iyo7aabanne Asaheela.
Abigiya Amaasa yelasu; Amaasa aaway Isma7eela addiya Yetera.
Esroome Sheesha
Hesiroona na7aa Kaalebas Azuubonne Yir7ooto geetetiya nam7u macheti de7oosona. I Azuubipe Yesaara, Sobaabanne Ardoona yelis.
Azuubi hayqin, Kaalebi Efraato ekis; Efraata Huura yelasu.
Huuri Ure yelis; Urey Basli7eela yelis.
Hesiroonas laythi usupun tammu gidin, Galada aawa Makira na7iw ekidi Saguba yelis.
Sagubi Ya7ira yelis. Ya7iri Galada biittan de7iya laatamanne heedzu katamata haaris.
Shin Geshuranne Soore kawoti Ya7ira katamata Qanaatanne iya yuushuwan de7iya usupun tammu katamata olidi oykidosona; yan de7iya asa ubbay Galada aawa Makira koche.
Hesrooni Kaaleba Efraata geetetiya bessan hayqidaape guye, Hesiroona machiya Abiya Tequhe aawa Ashihuura yelasu.
Yirma7eela Sheeshi
Hesiroona bayra na7aa Yirama7eela bayra na7ay Rama; kaaloti Buna, Orena, Oxeemanne Akiya.
Yirahim7eelas Ataaro geetetiya hara macha de7awusu; Ataara Onaama aayiw.
Yirama7eela bayra na7aa Rama nayti Ma7asa, Yaaminanne Eqera.
Onaama nayti Shamayanne Yada. Samaye nayti Naadabenne Abisura.
Abisura machiya Abikaala Ahbaananne Molida yelasu.
Nadaaba adde nayti Selidanne Afayma; Selidi na7a yelonna hayqis.
Afayma na7ay Yishi7a; Yishi7a na7ay Soosana; Soosana na7ay Ahilaya.
Shamaya ishaa Yada nayti Yeteranne Yoonataana; Yeteri na7a yelonna hayqis.
Yoonataana nayti Felitanne Zaaza. Haysati Yirama7eela kochata.
Soosanas macca na7ape attishin, adde na7i baawa. Soosanas Iyoheela geetetiya Gibxefe aylley de7ees.
Soosani ba na7iw ba aylliya Iyoheelas immin, Ataya na7a yelasu.
Atayi Naatana yelis; Naatani Zabada yelis;
Zabadi Eflaala yelis; Eflaali Obeeda yelis;
Obeedi Iyyu yelis; Iyyuy Azaara yelis;
Azaariyasi Kelesa yelis; Kelesi El7aasa yelis;
El7aasi Sisimaya yelis;
Sisimayi Salooma yelis; Saloomi Yiqaama yelis; Yiqaami Elisaama yelis.
Kaaleba Sheeshi
Yirama7eela ishaa Kaaleba bayra na7ay Moosa. Moosa na7ay Ziifa; Ziifa na7ay Mereesa; Mereesa na7ay Kebroona.
Kebroona nayti Qoraha, Tefuwa, Reqeemanne Shamaya.
Shamayey Yorqa7aama aawa Rahaama yelis. Reqeemi Shamaya yelis.
Shamaya na7ay Ma7oona. Maa7oni Beet-Xura yelis.
Kaaleba laggethiya Efa, Harana, Moodanne Gazeeza yelasu; Haraani Gazeeza geetetiya hara adde na7a yelis.
Yahidaya nayti Regema, Iyo7atama, Geshana, Falexa, Efanne Shafa.
Kaaleba laggethiya Ma7ika Sheberanne Tirihaana yelasu.
Qassika Medmaana aawa Shafanne Makibeenanne Gib7a aawa Susana yelasu. Kaaleba macca na7e sunthay Akiso.
Kaaleba nayti harati haysafe kaallidi xaafetidosona. Kaalebi ba bayra na7aa Huura ba mache Efraatape yelis. Huura nayti Qiriyat-Yi7aarima aawa Sobaala,
Beeteleme aawa Salmonanne Beet-Gadera aawa Hareefa.
Qiriyat-Yi7aarima aawa Sobaala yarati Haro7eetatanne Manuhoota yaratape baggata.
Qiriyat-Yi7aarima yarati Yatireta, Puuteta, Shumaatetanne Mishireta. Xor7atinne Eshta7ooleti haysatape yeletidosona.
Beeteleme aawa Salmoona yarati Naxoofata, Axiroot-Beeteyo7abeta, Manuhoota yaratape baggatanne Xor7ata.
Yaabexa kataman de7iya xaafeta yarati Tir7eta, Shim7atanne Sukata. Haysati Rekaabata aawa Hamaatape yeletida Qeenata.
